completion:
Date stamp all records.
3. Fill in the details of the following four columns accurately:

   **Reg. the identity of the tester:**
   Name of student, position applied for

   **Reg. the test date:**
   Format of date MM/DD/YY

   **Reg. the location where the unit was tested:**
   Just a few words to specify the location of the testing (e.g., Room 1001, Pamela's Test Zone, the student lounge near the dining room, etc.)

   **Reg. the serial number of the unit tested:**
   Some appliance have model numbers on the same plate as the serial number. Don't mistake the model number for a serial number. It will not be recognized. See the photo of an appliance that provides both the serial number and the model number.

4. Fill in or select entries in the appropriate cells of the following five columns for each test
